title: A Mark Against Thee Webtoon Gets Stage Musical Adaptation
content: Live Contents Group announced on September 15 the A Mark Against Thee webtoon is being adapted into a stage musical, with a full-length reading showcase scheduled for October 5 at Seoul's Sowol Art Hall.
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Biggest Sports Hit Returns With Big Screen Plans
content: Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s anime studio, MAPPA , has emerged as one of the biggest studios in the anime industry, with fandoms, especially shonen fans, hoping for their new anime to be animated by the studio.
author: ComicBook

title: Nobuhiko Okamoto Joins Bless Anime's Cast
content: The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed on Thursday that Nobuhiko Okamoto has joined the anime's cast as Ginga Yoyogi. The anime will star Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa and Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki. Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!

title: Netmarble Reveals Bloomwalker Game is Part of Ni no Kuni Universe in New Trailer
content: The "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday revealed a new trailer for Netmarble 's Bloomwalker game, which reveals the game is part of the Ni no Kuni universe. Netmarble additionally revealed the game will launch for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Atelier Karia Game Streams Character Video for Rutger, Lenja
content: Koei Tecmo started streaming a new character video for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories , a new game in its Atelier franchise , during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement Game's New Gameplay Trailer Streamed
content: The "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday revealed a new trailer for ArtPlay and 505 Games' Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement game . The gameplay trailer highlights new characters, environments, enemies, and new gameplay mechanics.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Game Streams Gameplay Trailer, Reveals Official Title
content: Com2uS Group streamed the "gameplay reveal" video and announced the official title GACHIAKUTA : BREAKOUT for its RPG based on Kei Urana 's Gachiakuta manga, during the "XBox Tokyo Game Show 2026" stream on Thursday. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Sixth Opening Featuring "EASY GO" by Kazuki Kato
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its sixth opening, featuring the song “EASY GO” by Kazuki Kato. The song was used in Episodes 127-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner
